strings.zh: 有种精灵{NEWLINE}只能在公园找到哦！

strings.en: Today is Tuesday, the day of the{NEWLINE}Bug-Catching Contest!{SCROLL}The rules are simple!{SCROLL}Using the one Pokémon you bring,{NEWLINE}catch Bug-type Pokémon. Whoever{CLEAR}catches the strongest one wins.{SCROLL}Would you like to take part?{VAR:0200:0}

Yes{VAR:0205}
No{VAR:0205}

strings.zh: 啊咧？{NEWLINE}精灵不是１只呢！{SCROLL}用最前面的精灵{NEWLINE}{VAR:0101:0}{CLEAR}参加{CLEAR}可以吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Huh? You have more than one Pokémon!{SCROLL}Is it OK to enter with your first{NEWLINE}Pokémon, {VAR:0101:0}?{VAR:0200:0}
Yes{VAR:0205}
No{VAR:0205}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}将精灵{NEWLINE}寄存给工作人员了！{SCROLL}那就把其他的精灵{NEWLINE}暂时寄存在我这里吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} left the other Pokémon with{NEWLINE}the staff!{SCROLL}We’ll look after your other Pokémon{NEWLINE}here for the time being.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 这是大会中使用的公园球！{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}得到了２０个{VAR:0108:1}！{SCROLL}
strings.en: These are the Park Balls used in{NEWLINE}the Contest!{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0} received 20 {VAR:0108:1}!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: zh 公园球 (Park Ball); the item name comes from {VAR:0108:1}, so the English just says ‘Balls’ | RV039: name: 公园球 = Park Ball

strings.zh: 抓到最强精灵的人即为胜利！{SCROLL}限制时间为２０分钟！{SCROLL}或者公园球用完即结束！{SCROLL}最后捉到的精灵{NEWLINE}归选手所有！{SCROLL}请大家加油捕捉最强的精灵！
strings.en: Whoever catches the strongest{NEWLINE}Pokémon wins!{SCROLL}The time limit is 20 minutes!{SCROLL}The Contest also ends if you run out{NEWLINE}of Park Balls!{SCROLL}You get to keep the last Pokémon{NEWLINE}you catch!{SCROLL}Everyone, do your best to catch the{NEWLINE}strongest Pokémon!
strings.notes: | RV039: name: 公园球 = Park Ball

strings.zh: 很遗憾！{SCROLL}好像不能再继续捕捉精灵了！
strings.en: Too bad!{SCROLL}Looks like you can’t catch any{NEWLINE}more Pokémon!

strings.zh: 这样啊。{NEWLINE}请下次参加哦！
strings.en: I see. Please join us next time!

strings.zh: 今天的选美大赛{NEWLINE}已经结束了哦。{SCROLL}请下次再来吧！
strings.en: Today’s contest is over.{SCROLL}Please come again another time!

strings.zh: 公园不时会{NEWLINE}举办大会哦。{CLEAR}如果愿意,你也参加吧？
strings.en: The park holds contests from time to{NEWLINE}time. Why don’t you take part too,{CLEAR}if you like?

strings.zh: 您是{VAR:0103:0}吧？{NEWLINE}这是您的奖品。{SCROLL}
strings.en: You’re {VAR:0103:0}, right?{NEWLINE}Here’s your prize.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哦哟？{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}的物品{SCROLL}好像满了呢⋯⋯{SCROLL}今天要是满了的话{NEWLINE}那我先帮您留着,{CLEAR}请您整理完物品后再来。
strings.en: Oh? It looks like {VAR:0103:0}’s Bag{NEWLINE}is full...{SCROLL}If it’s full today, I’ll hold on to it{NEWLINE}for you.{SCROLL}Please come back once you’ve sorted{NEWLINE}out your items.

strings.zh: 下次的捕虫大会{NEWLINE}请继续参加哦！
strings.en: Please join the next Bug-Catching{NEWLINE}Contest too!

strings.zh: 剩余时间{NEWLINE}还有{VAR:0133:0}分钟{CLEAR}要结束吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You still have {VAR:0133:0} minutes left.{NEWLINE}Do you want to finish now?{VAR:0200:0}
Yes{VAR:0205}
No{VAR:0205}

strings.zh: 这样啊。{NEWLINE}还有一些时间,{CLEAR}请继续加油！
strings.en: I see. There’s still some time left,{NEWLINE}so keep it up!

strings.zh: 这样啊。{NEWLINE}那么请在自然公园{CLEAR}等候结果公布。
strings.en: I see. Then please wait at the National{NEWLINE}Park for the results.

strings.zh: 我看到我儿子跟一个小女孩{NEWLINE}开开心心地去了自然公园。{CLEAR}他才上小学啊,{CLEAR}怎么能跟女孩子来这种地方约会呢！{CLEAR}我不能对儿子早恋坐视不管,{CLEAR}但是我直接去抓的话又怕打草惊蛇。{CLEAR}你能帮我去趟自然公园{CLEAR}抓我儿子早恋的现行吗？
strings.en: I saw my son happily heading into the{NEWLINE}National Park with a little girl. He’s{CLEAR}only in grade school! How can he go on a{CLEAR}date with a girl in a place like this?{SCROLL}I can’t just stand by and ignore my{NEWLINE}son’s puppy love, but if I go after him{CLEAR}myself, I’m afraid I’ll tip him off.{SCROLL}Could you go to the National Park{NEWLINE}for me and catch my son’s puppy{CLEAR}love red-handed?

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意帮忙！{NEWLINE}我儿子是个戴眼镜的小学生,{CLEAR}你应该很容易就能认出他。
strings.en: Thank you for helping! My son is{NEWLINE}a grade-schooler with glasses.{CLEAR}You should be able to spot him easily.

strings.zh: 请你一定要抓到我儿子早恋的现行,{NEWLINE}好让他无话可说。
strings.en: Please catch my son’s puppy love{NEWLINE}red-handed, so he won’t have a word to{CLEAR}say for himself.

strings.zh: 多亏了你帮忙,{NEWLINE}我才能即时制止儿子早恋。{CLEAR}真的是非常感谢！
strings.en: Thanks to your help, I put a stop{NEWLINE}to my son’s puppy love just in time.{CLEAR}Thank you so much!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我找到你儿子问过了。{NEWLINE}其实他是跟同学来自然公园{CLEAR}做精灵课题研究的。{CLEAR}这都是以学习为目的的课外活动,{CLEAR}请你不必过分担心。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I found your son and asked{NEWLINE}him. He actually came to the National{CLEAR}Park with a classmate to do a research{CLEAR}project on Pokémon.{SCROLL}It’s a school activity for learning,{NEWLINE}so there’s no need to worry too much.

strings.zh: 唉？只是普通的课外研究？{NEWLINE}难道是我太多心了吗……{SCROLL}好吧,但愿他没有早恋吧。
strings.en: Huh? Just an ordinary school project?{NEWLINE}Was I just overthinking it...{SCROLL}Well, I hope it’s not puppy love.

strings.zh: 希望是我多心了吧。{NEWLINE}我可不想儿子因为早恋{CLEAR}而影响他成为精英训练家。
strings.en: I hope I was just overthinking it.{NEWLINE}I don’t want puppy love to get in the{CLEAR}way of my son becoming an Ace Trainer.

strings.zh: 我只是想让口呆花和美丽花{NEWLINE}能够经常见面而已,{CLEAR}为什么你们一个个的都要说我早恋！
strings.en: I just wanted Weepinbell and Bellossom{NEWLINE}to see each other more often.{CLEAR}Why does everyone keep saying I’ve{CLEAR}got puppy love?!

strings.zh: 口呆花『Weee……{SCROLL}口呆花目光呆滞。
strings.en: Weepinbell: Weee...{SCROLL}Weepinbell is staring blankly.
